dict.string: Aster listens for voice commands and optional clap or snap wake while voice control is enabled.
Aster transcribes your spoken commands. Apple may process speech when on-device recognition is unavailable.
Aster reads your next seven days of events when you connect Calendar.
Aster displays your incomplete Apple Reminders when you connect them.
Aster reads unread message subjects and senders from Apple Mail when you request a sync.
Aster looks up the contact you name for a call or WhatsApp draft.
